page.overview:
What is Marvel Studios?

Ant-Man and the Wasp Avengers Black Panther Black Widow Captain America Captain Marvel Doctor Strange Eternals Guardians of the Galaxy Iron Man Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings Spider-Man Thor What If...? X-Men '97

Marvel Studios, also known as Marvel Cinematic Universe, is a licensed sub-theme that was first released in 2012 as part of the Marvel theme and based on the films and series of the Marvel Cinematic Universe. Since then, many sets, video games, and minifigure exclusives have been released based on various films and series.
